Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness
  • Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

 

Qualifications to succeed in this project:

 

  • Professional fluency in English
  • Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture
  • Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities
  • Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)

 

Why join the project:

 

  • Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling
  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains
  • Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment
  • Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset.
  • Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance
  Qualification path

How to get started:

  • Complete your contributor profile and application

  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Back-End

Front-End

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.

We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.

We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.


What you'll do
  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
  • Write video scripts and outlines.
  • Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.

What we're looking for
  • Native-level written and spoken English
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently

  • Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects

  • A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
  • Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
  • Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada


Nice to have
  • Previous experience creating educational video content
  • Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about
  • Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos


Working at Metics Media

At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. Role Overview:

  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

What we’re looking for

  • Strong proficiency in React, Next.js, TypeScript/JavaScript.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS for production workloads.

  • Solid understanding of web security best practices (OWASP, secure storage, encryption in transit/at rest, secrets management).

  • Experience building systems in or adjacent to healthcare, education, or compliance-heavy environments is a plus.

  • Excellent async communication, code ownership, and ability to work with a small, senior-led team.

  • Comfort working from a clear product brief and also proposing improvements proactively.

  • Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and observability tools.

Take-home assignment (Step 1 of the process)

Please complete a take-home assignment. You are allowed to use LLMs to write code. To ensure that your work will not be used at Fluence, we’ve made it unrelated to healthcare:

Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows

A simple app where neighbors list tools they are willing to lend, request to borrow from each other, and receive automated notifications and reminders handled by n8n.

Stack

  • Next.js (App Router)

  • Clerk for authentication

  • Convex for data + backend logic

  • n8n (self-hosted via Docker or n8n Cloud) for workflow automation

  • TypeScript

Requirements

Public page

  • The fictional company name is LendLoop.

  • Short tagline, e.g. “Borrow what you need. Lend what you don’t.”

  • Show:

  • A “Sign in to lend or borrow” button wired to Clerk.

Authenticated experience

  • Only signed-in users can:

  • List a tool with:

  • name

  • category (power tools, garden, kitchen, camping, etc.)

  • condition

  • short description

  • Request to borrow a tool for a date range.

  • Approve or decline requests on their own tools.

  • Mark a loan as returned.

  • Show:

  • All tools with availability status, filterable by category.

  • “My listings”, “My requests”, and “Incoming requests” views.

  • Nice, minimal layout.

Roles & rules

  • admin:

  • user:

    • Can create, edit, and delete only their own listings, and act only on requests involving their own tools or their own borrowing.

  • Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI.

Automation with n8n

  • Request notification: when a borrow request is created or changes status, Convex calls an n8n Webhook. The workflow notifies the relevant user (email, Slack, Discord, or a logged mock notification is fine) using only the fields it needs.

  • Secure the integration in both directions:

  • Sign webhook payloads (e.g. HMAC with a shared secret) and verify signatures on the receiving side.

  • Keep secrets in environment variables and n8n credentials, never in code or exported workflow JSON.

  • Make write-backs idempotent so retries do not create duplicate records or reminders.

  • Handle failures with retries and an error workflow (or equivalent) so failed runs are visible and never fail silently.

  • (Bonus) Show recent automation activity on each loan in the app, e.g. “Reminder sent 2 days ago”.

SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER

Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. 

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, operate and improve the infrastructure, platforms and tools that enable our teams to develop, deliver and run reliable software at scale.

Based in Cologne, you will join a team with broad ownership of our technical environment. We take a cloud-agnostic approach, combining cloud services and self-hosted infrastructure to meet the needs of our products and engineering teams. Our responsibilities span the full lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment to observability, security and ongoing operation.

You will combine infrastructure expertise with automation and software engineering to improve how our software is built, deployed and operated. This includes streamlining development workflows, integrating and maintaining shared tools, and supporting demanding workloads across data processing, media and machine learning. Working closely with engineering teams and colleagues across the business, you will build practical solutions that support our expanding product portfolio.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems, takes ownership from initial idea through to production, and thrives in a fast-growing environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. You will help shape how our infrastructure, platforms and tools adapt as the business grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

  • Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes platform across both self-hosted clusters and AWS
  • Own our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, driving a GitOps workflow to ensure all changes are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible
  • Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) and shared templates that empower product teams to build, test, and deploy reliably
  • Operate and scale specialized infrastructure for demanding workloads, including GPU clusters for computer vision models, media engines, and data analytics platforms 
  • Evolve our observability stack to proactively monitor system health, define meaningful alerting, and ensure high availability
  • Drive platform security and compliance through continuous vulnerability scanning, automated image screening, robust secrets management, and strict access controls
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to design scalable architectures and act as a strategic technical partner for new infrastructure initiatives 

Help define technical direction, engineering best practices, and quality standards within the infrastructure domain 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and scaling highly available production environments 
  • Strong hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, including upgrades, networking and troubleshooting
  • Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS) combined with experience operating bare-metal or self-hosted environments

Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and modern container build or GitOps workflowsStrong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between reliability, scalability, and maintainabilityExperience collaborating across engineering and product teams to deliver secure and robust infrastructure solutionsDeep understanding of Linux operating systems and strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) focused on automation and tooling. 

Nice to have – and what would make you exceptional:

  • Experience operating GPU workloads on Kubernetes or Machine Learning infrastructure
  • Familiarity with specialized Kubernetes ecosystem tools such as FluxCD, Rancher, or RKE2.
  • Experience working with large-scale video/streaming workflows or AWS media services
  • Experience managing and scaling messaging or event-streaming systems (e.g., Kafka) 
  • Experience operating and optimizing relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) 
  • Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling for engineering teams

WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

  • In 6 months time… You know our clusters and pipelines, handle incidents and upgrades on your own, and have shipped your first improvements to reliability, automation or security. You contribute confidently to architecture discussions.
  • In 12 months time… You own major parts of the platform, have delivered measurable improvements (faster deployments, better observability, stronger security), and help shape the roadmap of our hybrid cloud.

WHY CATAPULT? 

  • We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious,  intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. 
  • We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.  
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve.  There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! 

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

Engineering Manager - Platform and Data Intelligence  

About trawa

 

European energy costs are 2x compared to US and China. Electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. Market price volatility & complexity are here to stay. The backbone of Europe's industrial economy is at risk and companies need to act now.

trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that orchestrates procurement, energy management, and flexibility steering in one product. Supply, Manage, and Flex combined. That integration unlocks up to 30% in recurring electricity cost savings, all while helping companies switch to renewable energy.

We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast, the market window is open and we intend to own it.

trawa is a scale-up based in Berlin with ~100 FTE, ~30 of whom work in Product & Tech. We've raised over €35M to date, including a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic, and Tiny VC. All three founders are on board and 100% committed to build the utility of the future.

   

About the Role

 

We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead two teams that form the foundation everything at trawa runs on: Data Intelligence and Platform.

Data is the heartbeat of trawa. It turns the complexity of energy markets into savings and sustainability for our customers. Underneath it sits the cloud infrastructure powering our services and the IT and security practices that keep our systems and data safe. You’ll own the technical direction for all of it, from metering data management and billing to AWS infrastructure and internal IT.

You’ll shape a team culture grounded in trust, collaboration, and continuous learning, where engineers thrive and do their best work. You’ll report to the Director of Engineering and lead an established, growing group of engineers across two closely related teams.

At trawa, our culture is “office-first with flexibility”: most of us are in our Berlin office the majority of the week, with room to work from home when needed. The Tech team follows a more hybrid rhythm, with a minimum of 3 days a week in the office.

  

What You'll Do

 

Own the roadmap for our central data warehouse and the data platform our products are built on

  • Build a scalable data backend for the core processes of an energy provider, including timeseries data management, invoicing, and billing

  • Lead the design and operation of critical data pipelines, data quality standards, and observability practices

  • Run scalable, secure, highly available infrastructure on AWS for our mission-critical services

  • Drive great developer experience through CI/CD, observability tooling, and internal platforms that help teams ship faster and with confidence

  • Own IT operations and security: the tools, processes, and policies that keep trawa’s systems and data safe

Our tech stack

  • AWS, Terraform, Docker, GitHub Actions

  • Postgres, ClickHouse, dbt, Metabase

  • Python (pandas, polars), TypeScript

  • Dash0, Sentry, incident.io

  • Primo

   

Your First 90 Days

 

First 6 weeks (onboarding)

  • Build strong relationships with your direct reports, peers, and stakeholders

  • Understand each team’s current OKRs and how they impact the company

  • Get a solid understanding of our data architecture, infrastructure, and security posture

By month 3 (ramp-up)

  • Review operational health and tech debt across both teams, and present a prioritized plan for improvements in observability, data health, and scalability

  • Define and share a clear vision and roadmap for Data Intelligence and Platform, including how we improve developer experience

  • Assess our IT operations and security practices, and plan how they scale with trawa’s growth

  • Align next quarter’s roadmap with stakeholders and company OKRs, and communicate it broadly

 

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years in a technical leadership role with people management responsibilities, ideally in a fast-moving startup. You’ve led across multiple teams and know how to balance competing priorities.

  • Deep hands-on background in data platform/data engineering or platform engineering/SRE/DevOps, and solid working knowledge of the other

  • Strong AWS experience: infrastructure as code, cloud-native patterns, containerized systems, with a good grasp of security, reliability, observability, and cost efficiency

  • Clear communicator who builds trust across teams and with non-technical stakeholders

  • Inclusive leader who creates an environment where engineers of diverse backgrounds can thrive

Don’t meet every single requirement? We still encourage you to apply!

At trawa, we’re dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply – you may be the right fit for this or another opportunity.

   

Why Join Us

 

🌍 Real impact - At trawa, you will be part of a team that is dedicated to making a positive impact on the world. We value creativity, collaboration, and diverse perspectives.

 

🚀 Early ownership - We empower our team members to take ownership of their work and drive results, regardless of background or experience level.

 

🤝 Mentorship that matters - Regular leadership sessions, cross-functional exposure, and engineers who are genuinely invested in your growth.

 

📚 Learning culture - We provide an annual budget and dedicated time for professional development. You’ll have opportunities for mentorship, learning, and career progression.

 

🌐 Inclusive by design - We’re an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects that. Our tech organisation brings together over 15 nationalities, contributing a variety of languages, experiences, and perspectives. At trawa, we’re family-friendly with parents across all levels, and our diversity is represented throughout the company, including leadership. We’re committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

 

🎁 Solid benefits - We offer a competitive compensation package including salary and stock options, 30 days of vacation, and a range of benefits including subsidies for home internet and lunches, a Sports Club membership, a productivity budget for work essentials (e.g., headphones, monitor), dedicated learning days with an annual learning budget, plus a weekly team lunch and regular team events.

jobs.description_html:
Über uns

Probantica ist ein Anbieter für Qualitätstests aus Köln. Wir prüfen im Auftrag von Unternehmen, ob digitale Produkte und Abläufe vor Ort im Alltag funktionieren. Die Tests machen bei uns angestellte Qualitätsmanager:innen – Menschen mit Vertrag, feste Ansprechperson und klaren Vorgaben.

Worum es geht

Unternehmen müssen wissen, ob ihre Apps, Websites und Filialen im Alltag wirklich funktionieren. Als Kunde gehst du die angebotenen Abläufe durch: App öffnen, Konto anlegen, Formular ausfüllen, Bestellung abschließen, in eine Filiale gehen. Du testest den Prozess von Anfang bis Ende, dokumentierst jeden Schritt mit Uhrzeit und Screenshot und markierst die Stellen, an denen etwas hakt oder unklar bleibt.

Vor jedem Auftrag bekommst du eine Anleitung mit Schritten, Zeitrahmen und den Fragen, die am Ende beantwortet sein müssen. Kein Rätselraten, kein Vertrieb, keine Kaltakquise. Getestet wird auf deinem eigenen Gerät, in deiner Nähe.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Digitale Produkte testen: App, Website oder Online-Prozess einmal vollständig durchlaufen – von der Anmeldung bis zum Abschluss.
  • Abläufe vor Ort prüfen: in Filialen, Shops oder Servicestellen, mit Blick auf Wartezeit, Beratung und Abwicklung.
  • Auffälligkeiten festhalten: Screenshot machen, Uhrzeit notieren, in zwei bis fünf Sätzen beschreiben, was passiert ist.
  • Bericht einreichen: die vorgegebenen Fragen beantworten, Dauer je Schritt angeben, Ergebnis knapp zusammenfassen.
  • Nachfragen beantworten: wenn das Team zu einem Befund etwas wissen möchte, kurz und sachlich antworten.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du bist mindestens 18 Jahre alt.
  • Du hast ein Smartphone oder einen Laptop mit Internetzugang – Geräte für App- und Website-Tests stellst du selbst.
  • Du drückst dich in klaren, verständlichen Sätzen aus und arbeitest sorgfältig.
  • Du hältst Termine ein und meldest dich, wenn etwas nicht klappt.

Das brauchst du nicht

  • Kein Studium, keine Ausbildung in einem bestimmten Bereich, kein Führerschein.
  • Keine eigene Firma, keine Anmeldung beim Finanzamt.
  • Keine Kosten – weder für die Bewerbung noch für die Ausrüstung.

Vergütung pro Auftrag

Feste Pauschale je abgeschlossenem Auftrag, gestaffelt nach Umfang. Ausgezahlt wird monatlich, sobald der Bericht abgenommen ist – unabhängig davon, wie lange du gebraucht hast.

  • Kleiner Ablauf (Anmeldung, Formular, eine Seite) – ca. 60 Minuten – 19 €
  • Großer Ablauf (Konto, Antrag, mehrere Schritte) – ca. 90 Minuten – 29 €
  • Filiale vor Ort (inkl. Anfahrt) – ca. 120 Minuten – 39 €
  • Sonderauftrag (mehrere Geräte, mehrere Termine) – ca. 150 Minuten – 49 €

Richtwerte. Das konkrete Honorar steht in jedem Auftrag, bevor du ihn annimmst. Die Pauschale ist so bemessen, dass der gesetzliche Mindestlohn für die aufgewendete Zeit nicht unterschritten wird.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Faire Pauschale – bis zu 49 € pro Auftrag, monatlich ausgezahlt, ohne Provision und ohne Abzug.
  • Anstellung statt anonymer Crowd – Arbeitsvertrag und feste Ansprechperson statt Bewertungsplattform.
  • Minijob oder Teilzeit – Minijob bis zur Geringfügigkeitsgrenze (2026: 603 € monatlich), Teilzeit bis 20 Stunden pro Woche.
  • Flexible Einteilung – du sagst, wann du Zeit hast; keine festen Schichten.
  • Klare Vorgaben – jede Aufgabe mit Anleitung, Zeitrahmen und den Fragen für den Bericht.
  • Persönliche Begleitung – im Panel erreichst du deinen Supervisor direkt, ohne Ticket-System.
  • Kurzer Weg – Bewerbung in etwa zehn Minuten, Rückmeldung meist innerhalb von zwei Werktagen.

So läuft die Bewerbung

  1. Zehn Fragen beantworten (etwa 5 Minuten) – online, ohne Anmeldung, ohne Lebenslauf.
  2. Persönliche Daten eintragen – Name, Anschrift, Geburtsdatum, Kontaktdaten.
  3. Rückmeldung per E-Mail – bei einer Zusage kommen die Zugangsdaten für dein Panel mit.
  4. Arbeitsvertrag digital unterschreiben – Minijob oder Teilzeit.
  5. Onboarding im Panel – kurze Einführung, danach die ersten Aufträge.

Gut zu wissen

  • Keine Provision: bezahlt wird der abgeschlossene Auftrag, nicht die Anzahl gefundener Fehler.
  • Keine Vorkasse, keine Kaution, kein Verkauf an Freunde oder Familie.
  • Du bestimmst, wie viele Aufträge du übernimmst – es gibt keine Mindestanzahl.
  • Alle Geschlechter willkommen. Schwerbehinderte Bewerber:innen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt.

jobs.description_html:
We're looking for a CLX Property Advocate to help our UK customers through some of the most stressful moments they'll face as policyholders. You'll join our Claims Experience team and own property claims from first report to resolution, keeping every interaction fast, fair, and caring. This role is remote, and you'll need to be online during UK working hours.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In this role you'll

  • Handle property claims end to end across email, phone, and chat.

  • Investigate and settle claims independently, keeping resolution times tight.

  • Own the complex and sensitive claims where judgment, empathy, and experience matter most.

  • Prioritize your daily caseload so no customer waits longer than they should.

  • Partner with fellow advocates to flag edge cases and shape how we handle them.

  • Spot patterns in recurring claim types and share them with the team to build smarter processes.

  • Keep our tone warm and human in every conversation, especially the hard ones.

What you'll need

  • Hands-on experience handling complex and large claims, preferably in property insurance

  • Working knowledge of UK consumer insurance rules, including the fair treatment of customers

  • Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to explain a complex claim simply

  • A customer-first mindset, plus the empathy and patience to stay steady when someone is stressed or frustrated

  • Comfort in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift, and real curiosity about how AI tools can sharpen your work

  • A CII qualification, complex building claims experience, or time at a digital-first insurer (a bonus, not a must)

  • Ability to work in a remote environment

Role Description

As a Senior Full Stack Product Software Engineer on Dropbox’s Web Developer Experience (Web DX) team, you will help design and develop the application platform, developer tooling, and shared foundations that enable engineers to build reliable web experiences. You will take ownership of key technical systems, designing scalable architectures and delivering improvements that make software easier to develop, test, and ship.

You will work closely with product and infrastructure engineering teams to improve build systems, language tooling, and development workflows. Your work will include accelerating TypeScript feedback, automating migrations, simplifying development environments, and evolving shared application foundations. As AI changes how software is built, you will help create the reliable builds, fast tests, and repeatable workflows that support engineers and coding agents.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver ongoing engineering impact through ownership of developer tooling, application foundations, and web-platform systemsImprove typechecking, builds, tests, and local development to shorten feedback loops and increase reliability
  • Build automation for upgrades, code transformations, and migrations using repeatable validation and gradual rollout
  • Collaborate with product and infrastructure teams to balance technical requirements, developer needs, and business goals
  • Lead technical initiatives from architecture and planning through rollout and adoption, measuring their impact on developer experience
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to team development through technical guidance, code reviews, and shared engineering standards
  • Support the quality and operability of the systems you deliver through diagnostics, failure investigation, and agreed support arrangements

Requirements

  • 9+ years of professional experience in full-stack development
  • BS degree or higher in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent experience
  • Strong experience designing, developing, and scaling web applications or the platforms that support them
  • Strong programming and debugging skills in JavaScript, TypeScript, or another language, with experience working across front-end and back-end systems
  • Experience designing maintainable software, including component interfaces, dependencies, testing, and failure modes
  • Experience delivering software to production, including validation, rollout, and ongoing improvements
  • Demonstrated technical leadership, including architecture, prioritization, cross-team collaboration, and mentoring
  • Ability to investigate developer and system problems using measurements, profiling, logs, tests, and user feedback

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript tooling, compilers, bundlers such as Rspack, or build systems such as Bazel
  • Experience with CI, test infrastructure, dependency graphs, or developer environments
  • Experience with web infrastructure, application performance, service integration, or platform adoption
  • Experience with codemods, framework upgrades, legacy-system migrations, or AI-assisted automation supported by reliable validation

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

jobs.description_html:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:
You will assess a prospect’s technical requirements and apply extensive knowledge of Chainguard products to illustrate how a deal will satisfy the client’s unmet needs. You will cultivate relationships with decision-makers at all levels of an organization and negotiate the competing needs of multiple stakeholders within an organization. You will secure technical wins using methods such as demos, RFP/RFI responses, lead POVs, partner with engineering for requested features, and participate in conferences and industry events (when applicable).

What you'll do:

  • Partner with our Sales Team to help customers evaluate and prove the value of our solution
  • Focus on acquiring new customer “logos” in addition to growing existing customer base
  • Own all technical aspects of sales opportunities and assisting current customers understand the value of Chainguard
  • Day to day responsibilities include:
    • Listen to our customers and understand their challenges
    • Conduct product demonstrations and POVs/POCs
    • Actively participate in webinars, meetups, conferences and other marketing initiatives

What we're looking for:

  • Experience as a Sales Engineer / Pre-Sales Engineer
  • Experience with MEDDPICC and or Command of the Message sales frameworks
  • Experience selling into Enterprise (3+ years) and Mid Market prospects
  • Experience in the following areas:
    • Container technologies (Kubernetes, Serverless, Docker)
    • Cloud technology (AWS, Azure, Google, etc.)
    • Cloud security or containers security
    • App Security
  • Startup experience
  • Smart and passionate people that can persevere to success.
  • People acting as trusted advisors, able to build credibility with customers.
  • Strong team players committed to help and mentor their peers.

*Must be located in the UK or France*

By embedding intelligence directly into NetSuite, Zone helps finance teams move beyond reactive work to proactive, strategic impact. Learn more at www.zoneandco.com or follow us on LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/zoneandco.

About the role

Zone & Co. is looking for a high-velocity Account Executive to sell finance automation solutions to the Office of the CFO. We move fast, set ambitious goals, and expect our team to deliver. Our targets are designed to be achievable, and we're looking for disciplined, driven sellers who know how to manage a pipeline, maintain deal momentum, and consistently convert opportunities into closed business.

You'll own pipeline generation through strategic outbound prospecting, complemented by additional opportunities from our partner ecosystem and marketing team.

If you thrive in a fast-paced sales environment, are comfortable navigating short sales cycles, bring rigor to your MEDDPICC process, and enjoy building relationships face-to-face with partners and customers, this could be the opportunity for you. You'll also have the chance to develop deep expertise across a broad and growing product portfolio in a dynamic, expanding market.

What you'll do:

  • Own a net new number. Win new logos across a defined EMEA territory against an annual ARR target, measured monthly and quarterly.

  • Get out there. Travel to partner offices, industry events, and customer meetings. Face time with partners and clients is key.
  • Work the partner ecosystem. Build trusted relationships with our implementation and referral partners so they bring you in early and back you to close.
  • Run a high-velocity motion. Manage 30 + active opportunities at once and close 10–15 deals a month, from first call through pricing, paper process and signature.
  • Sell with discipline. Use MEDDPICC on every deal: find the pain, the metrics and the economic buyer, build a champion, and run a clear close plan with a next step every time.
  • Sell the whole journey. We are positioning the complete end-to-end story. We want to connect the customer pain with how to solve finance challenges, and turn that vision into bigger, multi-product wins.
  • Partner with Solution Consulting. Bring in SCs at the right moment for sharp, tailored demos on larger deals.

What success looks like:

  • Your pipeline is a good mix of self-sourced and partner-sourced from relationships you've built.
  • Partners know you by name and bring you into their deals early.

We are a small US firm that writes federal funding proposals for technology companies, for a fixed fee. We are looking for one US-based closer for booked calls. The role starts with a paid two-week trial.

The work

  • Our sales are written-first. A prospect replies to our email, receives a free one-page written plan, and picks a call time in writing. You take those booked calls, return calls from prospects who phoned us, and rebook missed calls. No cold dialing and no lists.
  • On each call you qualify, present our written fixed-fee offer (mid four figures to low five figures), confirm who signs, and ask for the decision. We send every agreement and payment link.
  • You send a short written report after each call, the same day.
  • Calls are in US business hours (Eastern Time). The work is remote.

Who fits

  • You are based in the United States.
  • You have personally closed B2B service sales of US$5,000 or more with business owners or technical founders, on the phone.
  • Experience selling to companies that pursue federal, SBIR or defense work is a strong plus.
  • You are comfortable following a written call guide and firm rules: no promises about outcomes and no discounts.
  • You do not currently write or sell federal proposal, white paper, SBIR or capture services for anyone else.

How we screen and what we pay

  1. Your written answers to the three questions below.
  2. Finalists record a 3 to 5 minute drill on a short script we send. The drill is paid: US$40.
  3. Every drill is scored on the same written scorecard.
  4. The strongest candidates are offered a paid two-week trial: US$45 an hour, up to 10 hours a week, plus 15% of the fees we actually collect on deals you close. The exact terms are in a written agreement you see before you start.
  5. The role after the trial depends on results. We do not promise a drill, a trial, a hire, or any number of hours, calls, deals or earnings. Call volume is modest today.

To apply, email these three answers. Everything is in writing.

  1. Describe one B2B service sale of US$5,000 or more that you personally closed: what the service was, the price, and who signed.
  2. Your city and state, and the hours you could work each week between 9 am and 6 pm Eastern Time.
  3. A prospect says, "Send me something and I'll think about it." What do you say next? Use your own words.

You will run the engine that pays roughly 350 GTM people accurately and on time, own the design of the plans, quotas and incentives behind it, and lead a small team of analysts.

Run the compensation engine

  • Own CaptivateIQ as our system of record for incentive compensation, including plan build, rule logic, testing and release
  • Own crediting and comp data integrity across Salesforce and downstream systems, and work with Systems and Deal Desk to fix problems at source rather than in spreadsheets
  • Oversee inquiry management ensuring clear SLAs and report on trends to improve overall processes
  • Document and keep policies and process up to date for stakeholders and your team

Design the plans, quotas and incentives

  • Collaborate with Revops business partners on the quota setting process for each function to ensure it aligns with broader compensation strategy and benchmarks
  • Model attainment distribution, benchmarks and support finance in ad-hoc cost reporting
  • Own and build SPIFFs and non-cash incentive programmes, including President's Club,

Evolve the compensation strategy as we grow

  • Build the compensation approach for an evolving pricing model and mulit-product business in partnership with the Head of Revenue Operations and VP of Finance
  • Represent compensation requirements during larger CPQ and CRM enhancements or changes
  • Enhance our approach based compensation reporting: attainment by role and segment, payout curves, quota coverage and programme effectiveness

Lead and grow the team

  • Stay hands-on. This is a doing and leading role, not a management-only role
